decision: Continuity-aware pitch correction becomes the leading offline D-STAR analysis candidate. The temporal objective offers an intelligibility/PESQ tradeoff; do not combine it by default. Neither voicing candidate is adopted. Public library implementation and defaults unchanged.
scope: Floating-point band-energy analysis plus full-grid, confidence-gated pitch correction; two auditory objectives; unsupervised and hardware-calibrated voicing; conservative gross-pitch repair and pitch/objective combination.
limits: Clean English speech, short clips, PESQ and ESTOI diagnostics, no listener verdict or streaming integration. New-speaker set was untouched for frozen tracked_pitch, then became validation data. Robust guard was developed afterward on the original 70 and not scored on the new holdout. Voicing classifier uses grouped cross-validation, with recordings grouped by LibriSpeech/ARCTIC speaker and by OSR source.

freeze.selection: Continuity-aware pitch correction selected on 70 development files and the earlier 16-file validation set before scoring any of these eight speakers. No parameter changes after selection.

heldout_manifest.selection: Eight previously unused speakers (four of each sex), fixed before candidate selection, first two utterances each, first 12 seconds. Selected before scoring on 2026-09-23.

assertions: Reusable pitch tracker exactly matches every recorded prototype pitch and original correlation.
Silence, voiced harmonic, unvoiced, gross wrong-pitch, reset and nonfinite-input checks pass.
Every result matches its recorded encoded-frame hash.
All indices are in range, D-STAR b8 is even, and frame/PCM lengths match.
Pitch-only trials preserve voicing and gain; voicing-only trials preserve pitch and gain; objective-only trials preserve all three.
Reusable metric preserves encoded fields and decoder PCM on two complete control streams.
Trial synthesis PCM equality is checked by score.py and combine.py.

from score import *
from scipy.signal import firwin,fftconvolve,lfilter
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'build/dstar-analysis'))
from prototype import energy_amplitudes,SYNTH
ENCODE=OUT/'compiled/Release/encode-model.exe'
TABLES=json.loads((OUT/'tables.json').read_text());PITCH=np.array(TABLES['pitch']);MIX=np.array(TABLES['mix']);VUV=np.array(TABLES['vuv'])
TAU=2*np.pi/PITCH[:,0];TIME=np.arange(-160,161);WEIGHT=np.hanning(321)
A=TIME[None,:]-TAU[:,None]/2+256;B=TIME[None,:]+TAU[:,None]/2+256
AI=np.floor(A).astype(int);AF=A-AI;BI=np.floor(B).astype(int);BF=B-BI
LOW=firwin(129,1200,fs=8000)
FILTERS=[firwin(129,[max(80,500*b),min(3950,500*(b+1))],pass_zero=False,fs=8000) for b in range(8)]
NULLS=[np.correlate(f,f,'full')[128:]/np.dot(f,f) for f in FILTERS]
MODES=['periodic_pitch','tracked_pitch','band_voicing','joint']
def window(signal,centre,half):
    start=centre-half;end=centre+half+1;out=np.zeros(2*half+1);left=max(0,start);right=min(len(signal),end)
    if right>left:out[left-start:right-start]=signal[left:right]
    return out
def periodicity(frame):
    a=frame[AI]*(1-AF)+frame[AI+1]*AF;b=frame[BI]*(1-BF)+frame[BI+1]*BF
    return 2*np.sum(WEIGHT*a*b,axis=1)/np.maximum(np.sum(WEIGHT*(a*a+b*b),axis=1),1e-9)
def voicing(channels,centre,b0,old_b1):
    tau=TAU[b0];rho=[];energy=[]
    for channel,null in zip(channels,NULLS):
        frame=window(channel,centre,256)
        a=frame[AI[b0]]*(1-AF[b0])+frame[AI[b0]+1]*AF[b0];b=frame[BI[b0]]*(1-BF[b0])+frame[BI[b0]+1]*BF[b0]
        e=np.sum(WEIGHT*(a*a+b*b));corr=2*np.sum(WEIGHT*a*b)/max(e,1e-9)
        noise=np.interp(tau,np.arange(len(null)),null)
        rho.append(np.clip((corr-noise)/max(1-noise,.1),0,1));energy.append(e)
    rho=np.array(rho);weight=np.sqrt(np.array(energy)+1e-9);weight/=max(weight.sum(),1e-9)
    loss=np.sum(weight*(MIX-rho)**2,axis=1)+.05*np.sum(weight*(MIX-MIX[old_b1])**2,axis=1)
    best=int(np.argmin(loss))
    if loss[old_b1]-loss[best]<.02:best=old_b1
    return best,rho,weight
def generate(n,input_dir,modes):
    ref=read_wav(input_dir/f'{n}.wav');signal=lfilter([1,-1],[1,-.99],ref*32768)
    low=fftconvolve(signal,LOW,'same');channels=[fftconvolve(signal,f,'same') for f in FILTERS]
    originals=[]
    for line in (MODELS/f'{n}.energy_grid.model').read_text().splitlines():
        v=line.split();originals.append((int(v[0]),int(v[1]),int(v[2]),float(v[3]),np.array(list(map(float,v[4:])))))
    output={m:[] for m in modes};trace=[];last=originals[0][0]
    for i,(old0,old1,oldL,oldw0,oldshape) in enumerate(originals):
        centre=(i+1)*160-519
        corr=periodicity(window(low,centre,256));voiced=bool(np.any(VUV[old1]))
        distance=abs(np.log2(PITCH[:,0]/PITCH[old0,0]));continuity=abs(np.log2(PITCH[:,0]/PITCH[last,0]))
        best=int(np.argmax(corr-.025*distance));tracked=int(np.argmax(corr-.02*distance-.03*np.minimum(continuity,1)))
        if not(voiced and corr[best]>.8 and corr[best]-corr[old0]>.06):best=old0
        if not(voiced and corr[tracked]>.7 and corr[tracked]-corr[old0]>.035):tracked=old0
        last=tracked
        oldvoice,rho,weight=voicing(channels,centre,old0,old1)
        jointvoice,_,_=voicing(channels,centre,tracked,old1)
        choices={'periodic_pitch':(best,old1),'tracked_pitch':(tracked,old1),'band_voicing':(old0,oldvoice),'joint':(tracked,jointvoice)}
        for mode in modes:
            b0,b1=choices[mode];w0,L=PITCH[b0];L=int(L)
            if b0==old0:shape=oldshape.copy()
            else:
                amplitude=energy_amplitudes(window(signal,centre,110),w0,L)
                shape=np.log2(np.maximum(amplitude,1e-6));shape+=oldshape.mean()-shape.mean()
            output[mode].append(f'{b0} {b1} {L} {w0:.9g} '+' '.join(f'{s:.9g}' for s in shape)+'\n')
        trace.append({'frame':i,'old_b0':old0,'old_b1':old1,'periodic_b0':best,'tracked_b0':tracked,'voicing_b1':oldvoice,'joint_b1':jointvoice,'old_correlation':float(corr[old0]),'tracked_correlation':float(corr[tracked]),'band_periodicity':rho.tolist(),'band_weight':weight.tolist()})
    for mode,lines in output.items():(OUT/f'{n}.{mode}.model').write_text(''.join(lines))
    (OUT/f'{n}.analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace))
    return ref,trace
def task(n,modes,input_dir):
    ref,trace=generate(n,input_dir,modes);rows={}
    for mode in ['base','energy',*modes]:
        model=MODELS/f'{n}.{"base" if mode=="base" else "energy_grid"}.model' if mode in ['base','energy'] else OUT/f'{n}.{mode}.model'
        indices=OUT/f'{n}.{mode}.indices';frames=OUT/f'{n}.{mode}.dvsi';audio=OUT/f'{n}.{mode}.wav'
        run(ENCODE,model,indices);run(BASE,'frames','--rate','dstar',indices,frames)
        if mode=='base':assert frames.read_bytes()==(MODELS/f'{n}.base.quant.dvsi').read_bytes()
        run(BASE,'decode','--rate','dstar',frames,audio)
        rows[mode]={**score(ref,read_wav(audio),None),'frames_sha256':hashlib.sha256(frames.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    stats={m:sum(t['old_b0']!=t['periodic_b0' if m=='periodic_pitch' else 'tracked_b0'] for t in trace) for m in ['periodic_pitch','tracked_pitch']}
    stats['voicing']=sum(t['old_b1']!=t['voicing_b1'] for t in trace);stats['frames']=len(trace)
    return n,rows,stats
if __name__=='__main__':
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--all',action='store_true');ap.add_argument('--only',nargs='+');ap.add_argument('--modes',nargs='+',default=MODES);ap.add_argument('--out',default='analysis-pilot.json');ap.add_argument('--input-dir',type=Path,default=ROOT/'testdata/corpus');ap.add_argument('--manifest',type=Path);a=ap.parse_args()
    names=[r['name'] for r in json.loads(a.manifest.read_text())['files']] if a.manifest else a.only or (list(json.loads((MODELS/'quant-70.json').read_text())['files']) if a.all else PILOT)
    report={'files':{},'changes':{}}
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
        for future in as_completed([pool.submit(task,n,a.modes,a.input_dir) for n in names]):
            n,row,stats=future.result();report['files'][n]=row;report['changes'][n]=stats
            report['summary']=summaries(report['files'],a.modes);report['versus_float']=summaries(report['files'],a.modes,'energy')
            (OUT/a.out).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
            print(n,{m:round(row[m]['pesq']-row['energy']['pesq'],3) for m in a.modes},stats,flush=True)
    print(json.dumps(report['versus_float'],indent=2))

from analysis import *
from dstar_pitch import DstarPitchTracker,lowpass_for_pitch
if __name__=='__main__':
    total=0;changed=0
    names=list(json.loads((OUT/'analysis-full.json').read_text())['files'])+list(json.loads((OUT/'analysis-validation.json').read_text())['files'])+list(json.loads((OUT/'analysis-heldout.json').read_text())['files'])
    new=set(r['name'] for r in json.loads((OUT/'heldout/index.json').read_text())['files'])
    for n in names:
        folder=OUT/'heldout' if n in new else MODELS/'heldout' if n.startswith('heldout_') else ROOT/'testdata/corpus'
        pcm=read_wav(folder/f'{n}.wav')*32768;low=lowpass_for_pitch(lfilter([1,-1],[1,-.99],pcm))
        tracker=DstarPitchTracker(PITCH[:,0]);trace=json.loads((OUT/f'{n}.analysis.json').read_text())
        for i,t in enumerate(trace):
            chosen,corr=tracker.select(window(low,(i+1)*160-519,256),t['old_b0'],bool(np.any(VUV[t['old_b1']])))
            assert chosen==t['tracked_b0'],(n,i,chosen,t['tracked_b0'])
            assert abs(corr[t['old_b0']]-t['old_correlation'])<1e-12
            total+=1;changed+=chosen!=t['old_b0']
    tracker=DstarPitchTracker(PITCH[:,0]);zero=np.zeros(513)
    assert tracker.select(zero,60,True)[0]==60
    # A stable harmonic signal is retained; an unvoiced frame never changes pitch.
    tone=np.cos(np.arange(-256,257)*PITCH[48,0]);tracker.reset()
    assert tracker.select(tone,48,True)[0]==48
    tracker.reset();assert tracker.select(tone,119,False)[0]==119
    tracker.reset();assert tracker.select(tone,119,True)[0]!=119
    invalid=np.full(513,np.nan)
    try:tracker.select(invalid,60,True);raise AssertionError('nonfinite input accepted')
    except ValueError:pass
    result={'recordings':len(names),'frames':total,'changed_pitch_frames':changed,'assertions':['Reusable pitch tracker exactly matches every recorded prototype pitch and original correlation.','Silence, voiced harmonic, unvoiced, gross wrong-pitch, reset and nonfinite-input checks pass.']}
    (OUT/'pitch-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print(result)

from score import *
def combine(n,input_dir):
    original=[line.split() for line in (MODELS/f'{n}.base.model').read_text().splitlines()]
    pitch=[line.split() for line in (OUT/f'{n}.tracked_pitch.model').read_text().splitlines()]
    assert len(original)==len(pitch);lines=[]
    for a,b in zip(original,pitch):
        L=int(b[2]);w0=float(b[3]);oldL=int(a[2]);oldw0=float(a[3]);shape=np.array(list(map(float,a[4:])))
        if int(a[0])!=int(b[0]):
            remap=np.interp(np.arange(1,L+1)*w0/oldw0,np.arange(1,oldL+1),shape);shape=remap-remap.mean()+shape.mean()
        lines.append(' '.join(b[:4])+' '+' '.join(f'{s:.9g}' for s in shape)+'\n')
    shaped=OUT/f'{n}.pitch_original.model';shaped.write_text(''.join(lines))
    raw=OUT/f'{n}.input.s16';ref=read_wav(input_dir/f'{n}.wav');raw.write_bytes(np.rint(ref*32768).astype('<i2').tobytes())
    indices=OUT/f'{n}.pitch_temporal.indices';trace=OUT/f'{n}.pitch_temporal.trace';frames=OUT/f'{n}.pitch_temporal.dvsi';audio=OUT/f'{n}.pitch_temporal.wav'
    run(SELECT,shaped,OUT/f'{n}.tracked_pitch.model','temporal',indices,trace,raw)
    run(BASE,'frames','--rate','dstar',indices,frames);run(BASE,'decode','--rate','dstar',frames,audio)
    sr,normal=wavfile.read(audio);rendered=np.frombuffer(Path(str(indices)+'.s16').read_bytes(),dtype='<i2');assert np.array_equal(normal,rendered)
    return n,{**score(ref,read_wav(audio),None),'frames_sha256':hashlib.sha256(frames.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
if __name__=='__main__':
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--all',action='store_true');ap.add_argument('--out',default='combined-pilot.json');ap.add_argument('--input-dir',type=Path,default=ROOT/'testdata/corpus');a=ap.parse_args()
    old=json.loads((OUT/'analysis-full.json').read_text())['files'];names=list(old) if a.all else PILOT
    report={'files':{}}
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
        for future in as_completed([pool.submit(combine,n,a.input_dir) for n in names]):
            n,row=future.result();report['files'][n]={**{m:old[n][m] for m in ['base','energy','tracked_pitch']},'pitch_temporal':row}
            report['summary']=summaries(report['files'],['tracked_pitch','pitch_temporal']);report['versus_float']=summaries(report['files'],['tracked_pitch','pitch_temporal'],'energy');report['versus_pitch']=summaries(report['files'],['pitch_temporal'],'tracked_pitch')
            (OUT/a.out).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print(n,round(row['pesq']-old[n]['tracked_pitch']['pesq'],3),flush=True)
    print(json.dumps(report['versus_pitch'],indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Prepare the fixed D-STAR validation set from the existing LibriSpeech archive.

Eight speakers absent from the original 70-file corpus, two utterances each.
Selection was fixed before candidate scoring; do not retune on these recordings
and continue calling them held out. Requires ffmpeg and the corpus dependencies.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tarfile

import numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]/"tools/corpus"))
from prepare import normalise, run_ffmpeg_to_8k

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SPEAKERS = ["4992", "5142", "5683", "6829", "7127", "7176", "7729", "8224"]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--archive", type=Path, default=ROOT / "corpus/raw/librispeech_test_clean/test-clean.tar.gz")
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=ROOT / "build/dstar-perception/heldout")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    index = []
    with tarfile.open(args.archive) as archive:
        files = sorted(m.name for m in archive.getmembers() if m.isfile() and m.name.endswith(".flac"))
        for speaker in SPEAKERS:
            selected = [f for f in files if f"/test-clean/{speaker}/" in f][:2]
            if len(selected) != 2:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing recordings for speaker {speaker}")
            for member in selected:
                raw = args.out / Path(member).name
                raw.write_bytes(archive.extractfile(member).read())
                samples, metadata = normalise(run_ffmpeg_to_8k(raw, 12), -26)
                name = "heldout_" + raw.stem
                wav = args.out / f"{name}.wav"
                wavfile.write(wav, 8000, np.round(samples * 32767).astype(np.int16))
                index.append({"name": name, "member": member, "speaker": speaker,
                              "sha256": hashlib.sha256(wav.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                              "seconds": len(samples) / 8000, **metadata})
    report = {"selection": "Eight previously unused speakers (four of each sex), fixed before candidate selection, first two utterances each, first 12 seconds. Selected before scoring on 2026-09-23.",
              "files": index}
    (args.out / "index.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Prepared {len(index)} recordings in {args.out}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']='1';os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS']='1'
import sys,json,subprocess,argparse,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor,as_completed
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];OUT=ROOT/'build/dstar-perception';MODELS=ROOT/'build/dstar-analysis'
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tools/quality'))
from compare import read_wav
from perceptual import score
from dstar_compare import summarise
from scipy.io import wavfile
import numpy as np
BASE=ROOT/'build/dstar-weighted/tools/mbe-cli/Release/mbe-cli.exe';SELECT=OUT/'compiled/Release/select-model.exe'
PILOT=['libri_1089-134686-0000','arctic_bdl_arctic_a0008','libri_1089-134686-0002','arctic_slt_arctic_a0009','libri_672-122797-0001','libri_121-121726-0002','arctic_slt_arctic_a0006','OSR_uk_000_0020','libri_672-122797-0003','arctic_slt_arctic_a0010','arctic_bdl_arctic_a0001','arctic_bdl_arctic_a0005']
def run(tool,*args):
    r=subprocess.run([str(tool),*map(str,args)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
    if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError((args,r.returncode,r.stderr))
    return r.stdout
def summaries(files,modes,baseline='base'):
    return {m:summarise({n:{'baseline':{'score':r[baseline]},'candidate':{'score':r[m]}} for n,r in files.items()},'score') for m in modes}
def task(n,modes,input_dir):
    ref=read_wav(input_dir/f'{n}.wav');rows={}
    raw=OUT/f'{n}.input.s16';raw.write_bytes(np.rint(ref*32768).astype('<i2').tobytes())
    for m in ['base','energy',*modes]:
        parms=OUT/f'{n}.{m}.indices';frames=OUT/f'{n}.{m}.dvsi';audio=OUT/f'{n}.{m}.wav'
        trace=OUT/f'{n}.{m}.trace'
        extra=[raw]
        counts=run(SELECT,MODELS/f'{n}.base.model',MODELS/f'{n}.energy_grid.model',m,parms,trace,*extra)
        run(BASE,'frames','--rate','dstar',parms,frames)
        old=MODELS/f'{n}.{"base" if m=="base" else "energy_grid"}.quant.dvsi'
        if m=='base':assert frames.read_bytes()==old.read_bytes(),('base control',n)
        run(BASE,'decode','--rate','dstar',frames,audio)
        if extra:
            sr,normal=wavfile.read(audio);rendered=np.frombuffer(Path(str(parms)+'.s16').read_bytes(),dtype='<i2')
            assert np.array_equal(normal,rendered),('synthesis state mismatch',n,m,np.max(abs(normal.astype(float)-rendered)))
        rows[m]={**score(ref,read_wav(audio),None),'choices':counts.strip(),'frames_sha256':hashlib.sha256(frames.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        if m=='energy':rows[m]['previous_float_frame_differences']=sum(frames.read_bytes()[i:i+9]!=old.read_bytes()[i:i+9] for i in range(0,old.stat().st_size,9))
    return n,rows
if __name__=='__main__':
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--all',action='store_true');ap.add_argument('--only',nargs='+');ap.add_argument('--modes',nargs='+',default=['compressed','temporal']);ap.add_argument('--out',default='pilot.json');ap.add_argument('--input-dir',type=Path,default=ROOT/'testdata/corpus');ap.add_argument('--manifest',type=Path);a=ap.parse_args()
    names=[r['name'] for r in json.loads(a.manifest.read_text())['files']] if a.manifest else a.only or (list(json.loads((MODELS/'quant-70.json').read_text())['files']) if a.all else PILOT)
    report={'files':{},'summary':{},'versus_float':{}}
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
        for future in as_completed([pool.submit(task,n,a.modes,a.input_dir) for n in names]):
            n,row=future.result();report['files'][n]=row
            report['summary']=summaries(report['files'],['energy',*a.modes]);report['versus_float']=summaries(report['files'],a.modes,'energy')
            (OUT/a.out).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
            print(n,{m:round(row[m]['pesq']-row['base']['pesq'],3) for m in ['energy',*a.modes]},flush=True)
    print(json.dumps(report['summary'],indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
"""Experimental D-STAR pitch correction for the offline quality harness.

This is the continuity-aware estimator evaluated in docs/dstar-perception.md.
It uses the existing encoder's pitch and voicing as a conservative prior. The
caller supplies a 513-sample, DC-blocked, low-pass-filtered window centred on
the existing amplitude-analysis frame. `lowpass_for_pitch` supplies the tested
filter. This module does not replace the public library's streaming encoder.
"""
import numpy as np
from scipy.signal import fftconvolve, firwin


def lowpass_for_pitch(dc_blocked_pcm):
    """Return a centred 129-tap, 1200 Hz Hamming-windowed low-pass result.

    The offline harness evaluates old samples from the encoder's existing
    history. Its 64-sample filter lookahead fits inside that history; this
    function alone is not a zero-latency streaming filter.
    """
    return fftconvolve(dc_blocked_pcm, firwin(129, 1200, fs=8000), "same")


class DstarPitchTracker:
    """Select a transmitted pitch only when periodicity evidence is stronger.

    `angular_frequencies` contains the decoder's 120 legal speech fundamentals
    in radians/sample, in b0 order. A fresh instance is required per stream.
    The existing voicing decision remains with the caller.
    """

    def __init__(self, angular_frequencies):
        self.frequencies = np.asarray(angular_frequencies, dtype=float).copy()
        if (self.frequencies.shape != (120,)
                or not np.all(np.isfinite(self.frequencies))
                or np.any(self.frequencies <= 0)):
            raise ValueError("Expected 120 finite positive D-STAR fundamentals")
        periods = 2 * np.pi / self.frequencies
        time = np.arange(-160, 161)
        a = time[None, :] - periods[:, None] / 2 + 256
        b = time[None, :] + periods[:, None] / 2 + 256
        self.ai = np.floor(a).astype(int)
        self.bi = np.floor(b).astype(int)
        if self.ai.min() < 0 or self.bi.max() + 1 >= 513:
            raise ValueError("Pitch period falls outside the analysis window")
        self.af = a - self.ai
        self.bf = b - self.bi
        self.weight = np.hanning(321)
        self.previous = None

    def reset(self):
        self.previous = None

    def periodicity(self, window):
        """Symmetric, energy-normalised correlation at every coded period."""
        window = np.asarray(window, dtype=float)
        if window.shape != (513,) or not np.all(np.isfinite(window)):
            raise ValueError("Expected 513 finite samples")
        a = window[self.ai] * (1 - self.af) + window[self.ai + 1] * self.af
        b = window[self.bi] * (1 - self.bf) + window[self.bi + 1] * self.bf
        energy = np.sum(self.weight * (a * a + b * b), axis=1)
        return 2 * np.sum(self.weight * a * b, axis=1) / np.maximum(energy, 1e-9)

    def select(self, window, original_b0, voiced):
        """Return (selected_b0, correlations); retain uncertain original pitches.

        Pitch distance is measured in octaves. The prior penalties are 0.02
        from the original pitch and 0.03 from the previous selected pitch,
        with the latter capped at one octave. A change requires correlation
        above 0.7 and an improvement greater than 0.035. These constants were
        frozen before the new-speaker validation, not fitted to its scores.
        """
        if not isinstance(original_b0, (int, np.integer)) or not 0 <= original_b0 < 120:
            raise ValueError("original_b0 must be a speech index from 0 to 119")
        previous = original_b0 if self.previous is None else self.previous
        correlation = self.periodicity(window)
        distance = np.abs(np.log2(self.frequencies / self.frequencies[original_b0]))
        continuity = np.abs(np.log2(self.frequencies / self.frequencies[previous]))
        selected = int(np.argmax(correlation - .02 * distance - .03 * np.minimum(continuity, 1)))
        if not (voiced and correlation[selected] > .7
                and correlation[selected] - correlation[original_b0] > .035):
            selected = int(original_b0)
        self.previous = selected
        return selected, correlation
